sentences.text: Some people could have ankle-deep water in their yard.
UT San Antonio says the phone warning can come after that.
So its researchers built a flood station.
It charges itself from light and needs no cell tower.
Four optical sensors at different heights watch the water.
The prototype also reads rain, temperature, humidity and light.
A small chip on the station runs the AI itself.
So it judges flood risk without a central server.
When the risk rises, a radio signal leaves the station.
It can carry more than a half-mile through city streets.
In open country it can carry up to five miles, to a hub.
At the hub, a second, larger AI model draws a map.
It shows how flooding could spread, for emergency responders.
Validation accuracy was ninety eight point eight two percent.
The university reports it from early assessments after training.
It names no town that has installed one.
